role.title: Bank intake officer
role.responsibilities: Understand reported account, payment and credential concerns. Prepare a local summary and only the handovers supported by the report. Do not freeze an account or promise a refund.

facts.label: Reported action
facts.value: opened the link and entered banking password and a one-time code
facts.evidence: opened the link and entered my banking password and a one-time code

facts.label: Transaction status
facts.uncertainty: I do not know whether it is pending or completed

facts.label: Information shared
facts.evidence: opened the link and entered my banking password and a one-time code

facts.label: Organisations already contacted
facts.evidence: have not contacted the bank or mobile provider yet

facts.label: Evidence the person can provide
facts.evidence: I have the message on my phone

questions.text: Do you know whether the unfamiliar debit is pending or completed?
questions.purpose: Clarifies whether the reported debit has settled or is still pending.

questions.text: Is the sender still in contact, or did you reply to the message?
questions.purpose: Establishes whether the sender can still contact the affected person.

questions.text: When did you receive the text message and notice the debit?
questions.purpose: Records the timing of the message and the later debit.

types.label: Suspected phishing
types.reason: A text message with a link led to banking password and one-time code entry, followed by an unfamiliar debit.
types.evidence: opened the link and entered my banking password and a one-time code

attention.text: Credential entry followed by an unfamiliar debit needs prompt review.

recommendations.action: Assess the reported account and payment concern with a human reviewer; do not promise an account freeze or refund.
recommendations.reason: The report includes credentials entered after a link and an unfamiliar debit.

messages.text: I received a text message claiming to be SYN Bank A. I opened the link and entered my banking password and a one-time code. Later I noticed an unfamiliar AUD 2,000 debit. I do not know whether it is pending or completed. I have the message on my phone and have not contacted the bank or mobile provider yet.

The latest text is an initial report about a text message claiming to be SYN Bank A, a link that was opened, banking password and one-time code details entered, and a later unfamiliar AUD 2,000 debit. This supports a suspected phishing concern with an account/payment review. Recorded the text-message channel, claimed identity, reported action, shared-information category, amount and currency, observed issue, that the debit status is unknown, that the bank and mobile provider have not been contacted, and that the message is on the phone. Still unclear: whether the debit is pending or completed, whether contact with the sender continues, and when the message and debit occurred.

I have 3 questions to clarify this case, covering Clarifies whether the reported debit has settled or is still pending.; Establishes whether the sender can still contact the affected person.; Records the timing of the message and the later debit.. You can answer more than one, say you do not know, skip a question, or end early.
